hooks.command: COMMAND=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$COMMAND" in "git push"|"git push "*) ;; *"git push"*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "Run git push as its own standalone command (not chained with &&, ;, or a pipe) so the push gate can parse exactly what is being pushed."}}'; exit 0 ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$COMMAND" in *--all*|*--mirror*|*--tags*|*:*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "The push gate only supports a plain single-branch push (git push [-u] origin <branch>, optionally --force-with-lease/--force/-f), matching the git-push convention documented for this repository. --all, --mirror, --tags and colon refspecs are not supported: the verification sentinel only covers the current HEAD, and any of those forms can push other, unverified refs alongside it."}}'; exit 0 ;; esac; set -- $COMMAND; shift 2; POSITIONAL=0; for w in "$@"; do case "$w" in -*) ;; *) POSITIONAL=$((POSITIONAL+1)) ;; esac; done; if [ "$POSITIONAL" -gt 2 ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "The push gate only supports pushing one branch at a time. This command names more than one ref; split it into separate git push invocations so each can be verified against its own HEAD."}}'; exit 0; fi; HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); FILE=".claude/.ci-guard-verified"; if [ -f "$FILE" ] && [ "$(cat "$FILE" 2>/dev/null)" = "$HEAD" ]; then exit 0; fi; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "Run the ci-guard subagent (.claude/agents/ci-guard.md) against the current commit before pushing. It mirrors this repository CI checks locally and screens for the failure patterns that have repeatedly broken CI here. It records verification for the current commit when everything passes, after which this push is allowed through."}}'
hooks.statusMessage: Checking ci-guard verification for this commit...
